Hero.caption:
Scaling nature-based solutions with participatory

land use and cover mapping platform

Section1.title:
Overcoming Map

Data Barriers
Section1.caption: Empower land use and land cover (LULC) planning and monitoring with intuitive tools that turn complex data into actionable maps.
Section1.item1Description: With Epistem, mapping your landscape becomes simple and powerful. Focus on the land use and land cover classes that matter most and create your own maps with user-friendly tools (no coding needed!) from publicly available satellite data.
Section1.item2Description: Creating your own land use and land cover maps is just the start. Discover how your landscape changes with Epistem's tools, providing transparent data and a consistent approach for planning and monitoring sustainable interventions.
Section1.item3Description: High-quality land use and land cover maps rely on robust reference data and mapping methodology. Through Epistem, you can access expert-processed satellite imagery, reference datasets, and mapping solutions from a community of remote-sensing enthusiasts and nature-based solutions practitioners.
Section1.item4Caption: Contribute to a growing open-source community
Section1.item4Description: Epistem platforms are built with transparent and scalable, open-source approaches. Contribute by adding or improving datasets and mapping solutions, and benefit from the community's collective power to overcome map data barriers.

Section2.title: Browse Application
Section2.caption: Explore Epistem applications to create maps, track changes, access high-quality data, and collaborate with an open-source community.
Section2.item1Subtitle:
Map past trends,

plan future action
Section2.item1Description:
Intuitive no-coding interface for creating, analysing,

and collectively acting on customizable land use and land cover map data.
Section2.item2Title: Rona (Repository for Open-source laNd use Analysis)
Section2.item2Description:
Scalable repository of participatory land use

and land cover mapping.

Section3.title: The Approach
Section3.caption: Epistem integrates scientific rigor with real-world usability, making mapping and monitoring easier, smarter, and more inclusive.
Section3.item1Description: Focuses on technical solutions that are scientifically sound, provides reliable, high-resolution data and tools grounded in research and tailored for field implementation.
Section3.item2Description: Effective solutions emerge only when those implementing change help shape the tools that drive it. Developed collaboratively with local actors and stakeholders, the system is transparent, open-source, and accessible, fostering usability and long-term ownership.
Section3.item3Description: Epistem handles complex coding and data processing behind the scenes, allowing users to generate maps and insights with ease, turning advanced science into actionable solutions.

Section4.title: About Us
Section4.caption: Supporting change-makers with data-driven solutions built for their sustainable restoration goals
Section4.description: Epistem is a consortium-led initiative combining global research expertise with local knowledge to bridge the gap between science, data, and implementation of nature-based solutions. Convened by IIASA, in partnership with CIFOR-ICRAF and WRI Indonesia, Epistem delivers practical tools for real-world impact.
Section4.item1Description: Epistem is initiated by a consortium led by the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (<a1>IIASA</a1>), in partnership with The Center for International Forestry Research and World Agroforestry (<a2>CIFOR-ICRAF</a2>) and World Resources Institute Indonesia (<a3>WRI Indonesia</a3>).
Section4.item2Description: The initiative combines global research expertise with deep local knowledge to bridge the gap between science, data, and real-world nature-based solutions.
Section4.item3Description: NbS actors often face technical barriers to accessing reliable, high-quality data that reflects diverse landscape realities. Effective NbS depend heavily on land use and land cover (LULC) data to guide planning, mobilize financial and institutional resources, and monitor implementation.
Section4.item4Description: Providing LULC data that is timely, accurate, and thematically detailed can significantly enhance the effectiveness, accountability, and impact of NbS interventions.
Section4.item5Description: Epistem strives to eliminate data barriers by providing thematically relevant, high-resolution, and accessible data tailored to diverse user needs, enabling NbS actors to focus on driving real change.
Section4.item6Description: Through a participatory approach, Epistem empowers stakeholders across the NbS delivery chain to use data that enhances planning, implementation, and monitoring throughout Indonesia and Southeast Asia.
Section4.item7Description: This data empowerment enables more sustainable and equitable land management, delivering multiple co-benefits such as:
Section4.item8Description:
• Climate change adaptation and mitigation
  • Biodiversity conservation and enhancement
  • Improved livelihoods for indigenous peoples and local communities

meta.title: Data Democratization for Sustainable Landscapes:
meta.subtitle: Mapathon Gotong Royong for Collaborative Land Use and Land Cover Mapping

summary.label: ABOUT THE EVENT
summary.title: Activity
summary.p1: The Data Democratization for Sustainable Landscapes workshop is part of the Epistem (Evolving Participatory Information System for Nature-based Climate Solutions) initiative, which aims to strengthen sustainable landscape management through a collaborative and participatory mapping approach. This activity is based on the need for accurate, open, and easily accessible land use and land cover data to support forest restoration, prevent deforestation, and achieve Indonesia's climate targets, including the 2030 FOLU Net Sink agenda.
summary.p2: Through a collaboration between IIASA, BRIN, CIFOR-ICRAF, and WRI Indonesia, Epistem has developed a web-based mapping platform called Luma Land Use Mapping for All, an open-source online mapping platform that has been tested with communities of practitioners in several regions in Indonesia and will be launched during this workshop.
summary.p3: The workshop will combine strategic presentations, technology demonstrations, hands-on practice, and map discussion sessions to build a shared understanding of modular mapping, shared reference data management, and strengthening collaborative networks across stakeholders. Commemorating National Awakening Day, the Epistem initiative aspires to instill the spirit of this national movement milestone into its vision of “data democratization for sustainable landscapes.” This moment marks a revival of collective stewardship in land use governance through mapping gotong royong—bringing together practitioners, government, and local communities to advance nature-based climate solutions.
summary.p4: The event TOR can be viewed <torlink>here</torlink>.
